intro: Gol'dir, freed from the Syndicate, has information for Krusk in Tarren Mill. The Syndicate's leader, Aliden Perenolde, visited Gol'dir and spoke of making slaves of the orcs who stand against him, and brought a girl named Elysa who wore the pendant the Warchief desires.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this Syndicate. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
More important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
Now go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
This will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
